redfin.remarks: Welcome to this desirable Pasadena condo offering comfort, convenience, and an inviting open-concept floor plan . This light and bright two-story residence features 2 bedrooms and 1.5 bathrooms, with spacious living and dining areas designed for both everyday living and entertaining. The dining area opens to a private patio , the perfect spot to enjoy your morning coffee or unwind with a glass of wine at the end of the day. Upstairs, you’ll find two well-sized bedrooms and a full bathroom, along with ample storage space throughout the home. Additional features include an in-unit washing machine , two assigned parking spaces in the subterranean garage, and the convenience of a well-maintained community with only 16 units. Move-in ready and ideally situated in desirable Pasadena, this charming condo is a wonderful opportunity for those looking for a comfortable home in a welcoming setting.
